title: Legacy NVD data-feed property
source: Dependency-Check 9.0.0 (2023-11-22) moved from the NVD data feed to the NVD API
fix: delete the line; set nvdApiKey (or nvdDatafeedUrl for a mirror)

title: Hardcoded NVD API key or OSS Index password
source: NVD API key terms + Dependency-Check docs (nvdApiServerId / ossIndexServerId read settings.xml)

title: No NVD API key configured
source: Dependency-Check README: without an NVD API key updates will be extremely slow (9.0.0+, January 2024)

title: failBuildOnCVSS left at 11 (scan never fails the build)
source: dependency-check-maven configuration: failBuildOnCVSS default 11 = never fail

title: Suppression until date passed or within 30 days
source: Dependency-Check suppression schema: <suppress until="2020-01-01Z"> stops applying on that date
fix: re-review the CVE, then move until forward or delete the block

title: OSS Index analyzer on without credentials
source: Dependency-Check README: OSS Index enforces API tokens since September 2025; without credentials the analyzer is disabled automatically

title: Legacy OSS Index credentials
source: Dependency-Check README: Sonatype Guide migration began April 2026; legacy OSS Index tokens planned to be replaced before the end of 2026
fix: issue a Sonatype Guide API token and store it under the same server id

title: Nexus v2 analyzer deprecated for removal
source: Dependency-Check 13.0.0 release notes (2026-08-03): deprecate Nexus v2 support for removal
